metal_framework.geometry_basis: Shared oxygen in CIF bond table (identity symmetry only); M-O vectors use nearest periodic images, M-M separations use the same bridge images, and the metal-site shape uses bridge-connected unwrapped coordinates. M-M values are separations, not metal-metal bonds.

description: XAFYEK crystallizes in the triclinic crystal system with space group P -1. Reported CIF formula moiety: (C24 H28 Ho2 N6 O20)n,4n(H2 O1). From the CIF bond table, Ho1 (Ho) has 8 O neighbors; Ho1A (Ho) has 8 O neighbors; Ho1A_2 (Ho) has 2 O neighbors; Ho1A_3 (Ho) has 2 O neighbors; Ho1_2 (Ho) has 1 O neighbors; Ho1A_4 (Ho) has 2 O neighbors; Ho1_3 (Ho) has 1 O neighbors; Ho1A_5 (Ho) has 1 O neighbors; Ho1_4 (Ho) has 1 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 2 pairs, 7 components; largest component is a chain with insufficient metal sites for a 3D shape classification. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 3.920-3.920 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 109.87-109.87°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula [Ho(PODC)1.5(H2O)]·2H2O. Explicit grouped units in the article formula/name: 1 H2O (explicit grouped unit in article formula). Article name explicitly identifies I(II).
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review. Empirical formulas alone do not establish unique oxidation-state assignments or ligand connectivity; annotations above reproduce explicit structural notation only.
